findings.title: Sensitive data exposed in error messages
findings.description: The diagram shows Potential sensitive data in error message: 'Error: "Password field contains invalid characters"'.
findings.impact: Information Disclosure, Sensitive data leaked through error messages
findings.mitigation: Sanitize error messages and implement proper error handling
findings.matched_pattern: Sensitive data exposed in error messages
evidence: Potential sensitive data in error message: 'Error: "Password field contains invalid characters"'

findings.title: No multi-factor authentication (MFA) option
findings.description: The diagram shows Login flow does not mention MFA/OTP..
findings.impact: Authentication, Authentication, Accounts are more vulnerable to compromise
evidence: Login flow does not mention MFA/OTP.

findings.title: No account lockout after repeated failed logins
findings.description: The diagram shows Multiple failed logins allowed without lockout or CAPTCHA..
findings.impact: Account Management, Brute-force attacks are possible
findings.mitigation: Lock account or add CAPTCHA after several failed attempts
findings.matched_pattern: No account lockout after repeated failed logins
evidence: Multiple failed logins allowed without lockout or CAPTCHA.

findings.title: No password strength indicator
findings.description: The diagram shows Password entry without strength indicator feedback..
findings.impact: User Experience, Users may choose weak passwords
findings.mitigation: Add visual password strength indicator during password entry
evidence: Password entry without strength indicator feedback.

findings.title: No new device login notification
findings.description: The diagram shows Login from new device without user notification..
findings.impact: User Experience, User unaware of new device access
findings.mitigation: Send notification when account is accessed from new device
evidence: Login from new device without user notification.
